research_notes: Sources checked: projecthope.org homepage (Nepal flood alert banner confirmed), projecthope.org Nepal flood response article (27.08.2026), projecthope.org about-us and financials pages, ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer (EIN 53-0242962). Project HOPE has an active, dated (27.08.2026) Nepal flood response statement with an Emergency Response Team on the ground; no district-level detail or dollar figures published yet, consistent with the disaster being only 2 days old. HQ discrepancy: the org's own current about-us page lists 1101 Connecticut Ave NW, Suite 500, Washington, DC 20036 as HQ; ProPublica also lists Washington, DC. Millwood, Virginia (cited in the task brief) appears to be Project HOPE's historical/legacy HQ location, not the current one per the org's own site as of 28.08.2026 -- used Washington, DC per the live source. swc.org.np (Nepal Social Welfare Council registry) was not checked directly (per task instructions it is currently unreachable); could not confirm NP_SWC registration status. Attempted a dedicated 'where we work / Nepal' country page (404) and a separate contact-us page (404); could not source nepal_presence.mode, staff_count, or partner organization names. No IATI publisher record found or checked in depth. No warnings/adverse findings encountered in the sources reviewed (not exhaustively searched for watchdog/regulator issues).
